Brentwood Union Free School District had highest enrollment in Suffolk County in 2025-26
For the 2025-26 school year, Brentwood Union Free School District had the largest enrollment among Suffolk County school districts.
Brentwood Union Free School District had the highest enrollment among Suffolk County school districts, with 17,948 students enrolled during the 2025-26 school year, according to the New York State Education Department.
Of the students enrolled in the 2025-26 school year, 50.9% were boys, and 49.1% were girls.
Data also showed that most of the students were Hispanic, representing 86.5% of enrollment in Brentwood Union Free School District.
Among the 69 school districts in Suffolk County, Sachem Central School District ranked second in enrollment with 11,824 students, while William Floyd Union Free School District ranked third with 9,641 students enrolled in the 2025-26 school year.
Brentwood Union Free School District roughly covers schools within Suffolk County and has a main office in Brentwood.
In the previous school year, Brentwood Union Free School District also had the highest enrollment among Suffolk County school districts.
According to an analysis by World Population Review, New York’s public education system ranked second overall in the nation but placed 31st based on K-12 performance.
